author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಮಳೆಗಾಳಿ ಚಳಿಬಿಸಿಲ ನೆಪಗಳನು ಹುಡುಕುತಿರೆ
ಕಳೆಯುವುದೆ ಜೀವನವ ಕಷ್ಟವಾದೀತು
ಇಳೆಯೊಳಗೆ ಛಲದಿಂದ ಎದುರಿಸುವ ಛಾತಿಯಿರೆ
ಬೆಳೆಯುವೆಯೊ ಉನ್ನತಿಗೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you keep finding excuses in rain, wind, cold and sun,
life slips by and grows hard;
if on this earth you have the spirit to face things with resolve,
you will rise to great heights, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Someone who always blames the weather lets life drift by and finds it hard. Someone with the resolve to face whatever comes rises high.
